name: Annapurna Bhojanalaya (Mahaganpati Temple Trust)
why_it_matters: Temple-trust dining hall (Annapurna Bhojanalaya) at the Mahaganpati Temple — pure-veg, mostly subsidised pilgrim meals. The trust serves prasad-style afternoon lunches at near-cost (₹80-100/thali), not commercial restaurant cuisine. Justdial-listed; used by all Astavinayak group tours doing the Pune-Ahmednagar leg.
insider_tip: Lunch service 12-2pm only; arrive by 12:15 to avoid the post-aarti rush. Donation-based or fixed token. Cash only. Outside donation box at exit.
signature_address: Mahaganpati Temple, Ranjangaon, Shirur taluka, Pune-Ahmednagar Hwy NH-753, Ranjangaon 412209

name: Panchamrut Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: The closest pure-veg sit-down to Mahaganpati temple at just 400m — Tripadvisor-listed restaurant catching the Astavinayak pilgrim flow. Maharashtrian thali at fixed prices, modak available daily. Useful for travellers who want a commercial restaurant meal (cards/UPI) instead of the temple-trust dining hall.
insider_tip: Maharashtrian thali (₹250-300) at lunch is the order. Open 7am-10pm — the only sit-down within 1km open for both early breakfast (before 9am darshan) and dinner (after 7pm aarti).
signature_address: Ranjangaon village, 400m from Mahaganpati temple, Shirur taluka 412209

name: Hotel Shree
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor-listed 2.1km from Mahaganpati temple — multi-cuisine highway-anchor with veg + non-veg menus, useful for travellers continuing on the Pune-Ahmednagar route (NH-753) who want a meal beyond pure-veg pilgrim thali. AC dining hall.
insider_tip: Mixed-diet groups order veg + non-veg thalis side-by-side here (rare in pilgrim-village restaurants). Open 7am-10:30pm. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: Ranjangaon village, 2km from Mahaganpati temple, NH-753, Ranjangaon 412209
